## Checklist

- [ ] Commits are signed off (`git commit -s`, DCO).
- [ ] Changed C/C++ lines follow `.clang-format` (`git clang-format origin/main`).
- [ ] Tests cover the change, or the PR says why they can't.
- [ ] GPU-affecting: AMD and NVIDIA GPU suites requested on the head SHA ([policy](../docs/ci-quality.md#gpu-ci-policy)).
- [ ] User-visible: a line under "Unreleased" in `CHANGELOG.md`.
- [ ] Docs updated where behavior changed.
